messages:
Maya (ML): Quick heads-up — ran regional throughput/fairness sweep for the new quantized-2 q4_0 variant across us-east-1 and ap-southeast-2. Raw numbers attached.
Josh (Infra): Nice. Which GPU profiles? H100/A100?
Maya (ML): Both. H100 baseline, A100 v5 baseline, then q4_0 quantized on H100 and A100, plus kernel variant 'fa13' vs 'fa14'.
Lina (Research): Summary: H100 native (fp16) p50=32ms p95=120ms throughput=380 tok/s; H100 q4_0 p50=28ms p95=140ms throughput=450 tok/s. A100 fp16 p50=36ms p95=150ms throughput=340 tok/s; A100 q4_0 p50=33ms p95=170ms throughput=390 tok/s. Fairness skew (per-tenant latency ratio) increased ~12% on A100 quantized.
Henry (SRE): Do we have continuous-batcher config? Window size / max_batch_tokens used?
Maya (ML): Default cb config: max_batch_tokens=2048, max_batch_size=64, batch_window_ms=8. For these runs we tried batch_window_ms=6 and 12 as well.
Lina (Research): Noted differences: smaller window (6ms) improved p50 by ~4ms but reduced throughput 5-7% on H100 q4_0. Larger window (12ms) boosted throughput +8% but p95 regressed ~10%.
Josh (Infra): Region differences?
Maya (ML): us-east-1 (8xH100) had more headroom; ap-southeast-2 (4xA100) saturated earlier — kernel choice mattered. 'fa14' kernel reduced p95 on A100 by 9% vs 'fa13' at cost of -3% throughput.
Henry (SRE): Fairness: when tenants with long-context requests arrive, they hog KV cache causing short requests to spike. Suggest trying per-tenant max_batch_tokens cap (e.g., 512) and a round-robin scheduler between tenant queues.
Lina (Research): I ran a quick sim: applying per-tenant cap=512 reduced p95 skew from +12% to +3% on A100 q4_0, throughput -2% overall. Tradeoff looks reasonable.
Maya (ML): Perf-bot uploaded artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/bench/1782000456 — contains csvs and flamegraphs.
perf-bot: artifact created: s3://redwood-bench/eng-ml/1782000456/{h100_q4_0.csv,a100_q4_0.csv,configs.json}
Josh (Infra): Can someone paste the cb config we should test next? I can spin up a canary pool.
Maya (ML): Proposed next config:
```
max_batch_tokens: 1536
max_batch_size: 48
batch_window_ms: 10
per_tenant_max_batch_tokens: 512
scheduler: tenant_round_robin
kernel_preference: fa14,fa13
```
Henry (SRE): +1 to trying that. Also let's add a canary traffic split 5% for 24h, capture p50/p95/throughput and fairness metric.
Lina (Research): I'll run quality eval on q4_0 with that config too — need to ensure no generation regressions.
Maya (ML): Action items: Josh to create canary (5% 24h), Lina run evals, Henry add monitoring alert for tenant-skew > 8%. I'll post back with updated numbers tomorrow. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Josh (Infra): On it.
Henry (SRE): I'll add alert: metric 'latency_skew_percent' > 8 => pager to eng-sre.
Lina (Research): Uploading eval diff link when ready.
Maya (ML): Thanks all — keeping this thread for next-step numbers.
